canonical_name: User and Entity Behavior Analytics Not Deployed
description: User and Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA) for detecting anomalous behavior is not deployed. This signal indicates that unusual user or system behavior may not be detected.
applicability: Applicable to Level 3 environments requiring behavioral detection. Includes UEBA platforms, behavioral baselines, and anomaly detection systems.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through UEBA deployment review, behavioral baseline verification, and anomaly detection testing.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - System and Communications Protection
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
